verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Weaviate replicates data across multi-node clusters via a replication factor >1 for high availability, but the evidence pack does not cite specifics of a documented consistency model (e.g., tunable consistency levels, quorum reads/writes) beyond the general HA claim. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of consistency levels/tunable consistency, cross-zone replication guarantees, and independent verification of HA behavior in production.
